progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Eb in Shahrashub. The line peaks at Gk4 (383.1 Hz) at 0:37.6. It closes on the tonic (Gk3 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → F4 → F4).
